offline: No connection to the PC. Try again when it's back.

messageActions.title: Message actions
messageActions.appendDetail: Adds the text to the current draft.

transcription.blocked: Allow microphone access to use dictation.
transcription.microphoneFailed: Could not record. Check your microphone and try again.
transcription.network: The connection dropped during dictation. Try again.
transcription.noSpeech: No speech was recognized. Try recording again.
transcription.busy: This PC is already transcribing another recording. Try again.
transcription.unavailable: The selected transcription provider is unavailable. Check voice dictation in Settings.
transcription.timeout: Transcription took too long. Try a shorter recording.
transcription.failed: Could not transcribe the recording. Try again.

slash.label: Agent commands
slash.none: This agent hasn't announced any commands.

fileRequest.hint: Choose a file, then send it to the agent. This does not send a new message.
fileRequest.invalidType: This file does not match the requested types. Choose another file.
fileRequest.uploadFailed: The upload failed. Retry with the selected file or choose another.
fileRequest.responseFailed: Could not confirm your response. Retry the same response; the file will not be uploaded again.
fileRequest.unavailable: This file request is no longer available.

cancelled.disconnected: The agent disconnected before receiving a file.
cancelled.session_ended: The session ended before receiving a file.

preview.label: App preview
preview.hint: Opens the app in a separate window on an isolated preview origin, without access to Nanachi storage or tokens.
preview.singleActive: One active preview per browser and PC. Opening another preview switches the target for all preview windows in this browser.
preview.connecting: Connecting to the app on your PC…
preview.opened: Opened in a separate window. If you open another preview, reopen this one to switch back.
preview.open_failed: Could not open the app. Check that its server is running on the PC, then try Open preview again.
preview.close_failed: Could not confirm closure. Try Close preview again to revoke access.
preview.popup_blocked: The browser blocked the new window. Allow pop-ups for Nanachi, then try Open preview again.
preview.unavailable: This preview is no longer available. Ask the agent to create another.

closed.closed: Preview closed. Access has been revoked.
closed.expired: This preview expired. Ask the agent to create another.
closed.session_ended: The session ended and preview access was revoked.

question.label: Agent question
question.hint: Choose one option to send your answer to the agent.
question.failed: Could not confirm your response. It may already have reached the PC. Retry sends the same response.
question.unavailable: This question is no longer available. No new response can be sent from this card.

cancelled.expired: This question has expired and no longer accepts responses.
cancelled.disconnected: The agent disconnected. This question was cancelled.
cancelled.session_ended: The session or turn ended. This question was cancelled.

queue.title: Message queue
queue.failed: Couldn't send. Remove this message to continue the queue.
queue.full: The queue is full. Wait for a message to send or remove one.

workMode.title: Work mode
workMode.confirmBody: The agent will run tools and change files on this PC without asking you first. You can switch to another mode at any time.
workMode.yoloDetail: Approves recognized low-risk requests. Select to turn on or off.
workMode.yoloLimited: Limited coverage. The agent may act without asking or send requests that need review. Select to turn on or off.
workMode.yoloConfirmTitle: Turn on YOLO for this session?
workMode.yoloConfirmBody: Nanachi approves recognized low-risk requests. Deletions, database operations, and commands that need review still ask for your confirmation when they reach the app. Some agent actions happen outside this approval flow.

status.queued: Queued: waiting for the agent to be free

command.intervalHelp: Interval between 30 s and 24 h, followed by the prompt. E.g. /loop 5m review the tests.
command.noAttachments: Loop doesn't accept attachments. Send the file in a regular message.
command.promptTooLong: The loop prompt is over {{max}} characters.

form.intervalRange: The interval must be between 30 s and 24 h.
form.promptEmpty: Write the prompt the loop will repeat.
form.roundsInvalid: Round limit: use a whole number, 1 or more.
form.firstRoundInterval: If off, the first round waits for the interval.

summary.dynamic: Will send {{prompt}} {{first}}; then the agent decides when to repeat, {{stop}}.
summary.untilDoneOrUpTo_one: until it says it's done or reaches {{count}} round
summary.untilDoneOrUpTo_other: until it says it's done or reaches {{count}} rounds

sheet.title: Loop mode
sheet.description: Repeats a prompt in this session, even with your phone closed.
sheet.confirmStopText: Stop the loop? A round in progress finishes, and no other starts.
sheet.promptPlaceholder: E.g. /review or review the tests that failed
sheet.intervalHint: Runs every {{interval}}, counted from the end of each round.
sheet.roundsHint: The loop stops by itself after this many rounds.
sheet.nativeNote: Sends the command to Claude as a regular message.
sheet.how1: Runs on the PC, even with your phone closed.
sheet.how2: Waits if the agent is busy or asking for permission.
sheet.how3: Pauses and notifies your phone if something goes wrong.

interval.title: Fixed interval
interval.description: Repeats the prompt at the same interval every time. The time counts from the end of the previous reply, so it never runs twice at once.
interval.example: E.g. every 15 min, run the tests and fix whatever fails.

dynamic.title: Automatic
dynamic.description: The agent decides when to run again: at the end of each reply it says how long to wait (30 s to 24 h) or that it's done, and the loop stops by itself. With no answer, it waits 10 min.
dynamic.example: E.g. keep refactoring until it's finished.
